concerns.text: Unsafe [P] tags. T002 is tagged [P] but its loader 'must verify these hashes' from data/raw/checksums.json, which is produced by T001 — a hidden ordering requirement making T002 not parallel-safe with T001. Likewise T003 [P] consumes unified_fatigue.csv (T002) and timing.py (T001); T004 [P] consumes unified_fatigue.csv; T005 [P] consumes T004's feature sets/scalers; T006/T007 [P] consume T005's saved models and test predictions; T008 [P] consumes unified_fatigue.csv; T009 [P] consumes T008's mediation_eligibility.json; T010 [P] aggregates artifacts from T003–T009; T011 [P] re-runs the whole workflow. Every one of these has an explicit producer-before-consumer dependency stated in its own Actions, contradicting the parallel-safe tag. Only T001 and T013 are genuinely parallel-safe (T013 'may run any time after T002' — also not parallel-safe with T002). Remove or correct the [P] tags to match the stated sequential execution order.
